name: Candlelight: Coldplay vs Imagine Dragons
description: Experience the anthems of two of the world's biggest bands in a new light, performed by a string quartet in a magical, candlelit setting.
longDescription:
Candlelight: Coldplay vs Imagine Dragons presents a unique classical interpretation of popular rock anthems. This musical event features a string quartet performing arrangements of songs by two globally recognized bands, Coldplay and Imagine Dragons. The series aims to recontextualize contemporary music through classical instrumentation, offering a fresh perspective on well-known melodies.

Attendees will experience an evening concert set within a venue illuminated by candlelight, creating a distinct atmosphere. The performance duration is typically around 60-75 minutes. The audience generally comprises individuals interested in both popular music and classical interpretations, seeking an alternative concert experience. The specific character of the venue will vary, as indicated by "Location Varies," but past Candlelight events have utilized historic buildings and intimate spaces.

Tickets are required for entry to this event. Information regarding specific venue details and transportation will be provided upon ticket purchase, as the location varies.
